title: signed-bundles: add manifest signing and helm chart SHA256 verify for air-gapped installs
author: Maya R. Singh
description: Motivation: In air-gapped/on-prem deployments the integrity and provenance of vendored artifacts is critical. Previously the installer accepted bundle tarballs and vendored helm charts without end-to-end cryptographic guarantees, which forced operators to rely on out-of-band processes. This change adds signed bundle manifests (detached signatures + public-key rotation support) and enforces SHA256 verification of Helm chart archives during install.
summary_of_changes:
- New bundle manifest signer/verifier (installer/pkg/bundle/signature.go)
- Helm chart SHA256 verification hook integrated into chart renderer (installer/pkg/helm/verify.go)
- Terraform module update to pin provider plugin versions and add provider lockfile (terraform/modules/airgap/provider_lock.tf)
- Mirror index enhancements to accept signed OCI index blobs and validate index signatures (installer/pkg/mirror/index_validator.go)
- CLI flag --bundle-key for operator-supplied public keys and rotation policy notes in docs (docs/installs/signed-bundles.md)
- End-to-end test harness exercising an offline mirror and simulated signature revocation (test/e2e/airgap/signed-bundle-test.sh)

testing_and_validation: Local: go test ./... and chart-verify against packed charts. CI: airgap pipeline builds vendored OCI mirror, publishes signed index.tar.gz, runs full installer bootstrap in an isolated subnet VM. Included a failing scenario in CI to assert that tampered charts are rejected. Manual: validated with a customer staging mirror and rotated a test key to confirm zero-downtime key rotation flow.
rollback_plan: Installer exposes --skip-signature-check for operator emergency rollback but this flag is strongly gated and requires explicit confirmation in the CLI and RBAC approval in Dedicated installs. Team runbook updated with step-by-step rollback and re-vendor instructions (docs/installs/signed-bundles.md#rollback).
operational_notes: Operators must supply a public key or point to the default Redwood keyring. For on-prem installs with HSM integration, we provide a helper script to export a PEM public key. We've added metrics: bundle.signature_verified_total and bundle.signature_verification_failures, and an alert template for >5 failures / 5m.
release_notes: Added signed bundle manifests and Helm chart SHA256 verification to air-gapped installer. Operators should pre-roll public keys to avoid install-time failures. See docs/installs/signed-bundles.md for migration and key-rotation steps.
notes_on_backcompat: Non-breaking: bundles without manifest signatures are still accepted if operator passes --allow-unsigned-bundles (opt-in for older mirrors). New default for new installs is to require signed manifests.
